title: PIM for Active Directory: grant the hybrid worker's identity its cloud access
purpose: Grants the hybrid worker's managed identity (Azure VM or Azure Arc server) exactly what it needs outside Active Directory: a database user in the PIM store, read-only Microsoft Graph roles and read access to the PIM source store.
whenToRun: Once per worker, after the infrastructure step and before Install-PimHybridWorker.ps1 -Phase Configure (the install fetches the code with the identity). -PrincipalId for the Azure VM's identity, -ArcMachineResourceId for an Azure Arc server. Runs in Windows PowerShell 5.1 or PowerShell 7 (on a PowerShell 7 transport failure the SQL step re-runs once in a Windows PowerShell 5.1 child; the token travels on its standard input).

runAs.name: Privileged Role Administrator
runAs.why: grants Microsoft Graph application roles to the worker identity

runAs.name: User Access Administrator
runAs.why: assigns Storage Blob Data Reader (Owner or Role Based Access Control Administrator also work)

runAs.name: Microsoft Entra admin of the PIM SQL server
runAs.why: creates the worker's contained database user and adds it to db_datareader + db_datawriter

changes.object: application permission (app role assignment) of the worker identity
changes.why: the worker reads the PIM groups and who is active in them; read only
changes.undo: remove the app role assignments in the identity's enterprise application

changes.why: self-update with the identity -- no SAS, no PAT

changes.object: contained user -SqlUserName created from the identity's application id
changes.why: the worker reads its work and writes its state and audit

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: The subscription (tenant check; the Arc machine's subscription).

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.help: The tenant; Graph calls follow it and the script refuses another.

parameters.name: PrincipalId
parameters.help: Azure VM worker: the VM's managed identity object id (the infrastructure step returns it).

parameters.name: ArcMachineResourceId
parameters.help: Azure Arc worker: the Arc machine's resource id; its identity is read from Azure.

parameters.name: SqlServer
parameters.help: The PIM SQL server FQDN (<server>.database.windows.net). Omitted: no SQL step.

parameters.name: SqlUserName
parameters.help: The contained user's name; one per worker.

parameters.name: SourceContainerId
parameters.help: The source-store container's resource id. Omitted: no storage grant.

parameters.name: GrantMailSend
parameters.help: Also grant Mail.Send (new AD admin accounts get their initial password by mail).

readsOnly: the identity's service principal and its current app role assignments
the current role assignments on the container and the current database principals (read-before-write)
network: management.azure.com, graph.microsoft.com, login.microsoftonline.com (REST, browser sign-in or an Invardia support session); the PIM SQL server on 1433; no Azure CLI, no PowerShell module
whatIf: Prints each Graph role, the storage role and the SQL user / role memberships it would grant; grants nothing.
undo: Remove the Graph app role assignments, the Storage Blob Data Reader assignment and DROP USER the contained user.
